shortDescription: Manages MLAG configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: dfs_group_id
options.description: ID of a DFS group. The value is 1.

options.name: eth_trunk_id
options.description: Name of the peer-link interface. The value is in the range from 0 to 511.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IP address bound to the DFS group. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: nickname
options.description: The nickname bound to a DFS group. The value is an integer that ranges from 1 to 65471.

options.name: peer_link_id
options.description: Number of the peer-link interface. The value is 1.

options.name: priority_id
options.description: Priority of a DFS group. The value is an integer that ranges from 1 to 254. The default value is 100.

options.name: pseudo_nickname
options.description: A pseudo nickname of a DFS group. The value is an integer that ranges from 1 to 65471.

options.name: pseudo_priority
options.description: The priority of a pseudo nickname. The value is an integer that ranges from 128 to 255. The default value is 192. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: vpn_instance_name
options.description: Name of the VPN instance bound to the DFS group. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters without spaces. If the character string is quoted by double quotation marks, the character string can contain spaces. The value _public_ is reserved and cannot be used as the VPN instance name.
